item.title: Fighting Discouragement and Depression, A Christ-Centered Encouragement for Men
item.description: Many men struggle silently with discouragement and depression. In this Warriors of Grace episode, Dave Jenkins shares biblical help and real hope in Christ from Psalm 42 and 2 Corinthians 4.

item.title: Many Hands, One Work, A Christ-Centered Look at Nehemiah 3
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Nehemiah 3 and highlights how God calls His people to work together in unity. Every contribution matters in His Kingdom work.

item.title: The Cost of Neglecting Sound Doctrine
item.description: Dave Jenkins addresses the alarming doctrinal confusion revealed by the State of Theology survey and explains why neglecting sound doctrine always carries a cost. He unpacks why biblical clarity is kindness, why sound doctrine is essential for discipleship and holiness, and how the church can recover theological conviction in a confused age.

item.title: Jesus Is the Only Way the Truth and the Life
item.description: In this episode of New Age to Christ, Doreen Virtue shares her journey of seeking truth in Christian Science, New Age teachings, occult practices, and conspiracy thinking before coming to saving faith in Jesus Christ. Through John 14:6, she explains why Jesus alone is the way, the truth, and the life, and why every other spiritual claim leads to deception and confusion.

item.title: Nehemiah 4, Building with a Trowel and a Sword
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, we study Nehemiah 4 and learn how God's people continued building the wall while facing opposition. Nehemiah reminds us that building God's Kingdom requires prayer, perseverance, and vigilance. Discover how this passage encourages believers today to stand firm, work faithfully, and trust the Lord to fight for His people.

item.title: The Incarnation and Redemption: Why Jesus Took on Flesh
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explores why Jesus took on flesh and how the incarnation is inseparably connected to redemption, the cross, the resurrection, and the Christian life.
